$comment: GENERATED by scripts/build-manifest.mjs — do not edit. Agents: pick components / constants from here, rules from docs/QUICK_REF.md.

list.name: Flat
list.description: Cool neutral greys, thin borders, no card shadows, medium radii, compact 34px controls, Geist. Dense, information-first screens: dashboards, tools, admin.

list.name: Sharp
list.description: Off-black ink and off-white, strong 2px borders, square corners, a hard offset shadow, Space Grotesk. Bold, editorial screens: landing pages, portfolios, creative tools.

list.name: Soft
list.description: Warm, tinted neutrals, borderless cards lifted by a soft shadow, large radii, roomy 40px controls, Plus Jakarta Sans. Calm, friendly screens: consumer apps, storefronts, onboarding.

components.name: Reasoning
components.summary: The model's reasoning above its answer. Open while `busy` (the text streams in), folded to “Đã suy luận trong 12 giây” once it is done; people can open it again. A toggle by the user wins over the automatic open / close.

components.name: ToolCall
components.summary: One tool the agent called: a row with its name and status that opens to show the input (arguments) and the output. Strings show as they are, anything else as formatted JSON; `error` shows in place of the output.

components.name: Sources
components.summary: “3 nguồn” under an answer, opening to the numbered list of pages it used (numbers match its `Citation`s).

components.name: Citation
components.summary: A numbered citation inside answer text, linking to its source; hover or focus shows the title.

components.name: TaskList
components.summary: The agent's plan: steps with their status and a progress count. The running step is marked aria-current.

components.name: ActionConfirmation
components.summary: An action the agent wants to take that needs a person's OK (send an email, delete files, spend money). Shows what it will do, then Cho phép / Từ chối; once decided, the outcome replaces the buttons so the log stays readable.

components.name: FileTree
components.summary: Files and folders (a repo, a diff, an export): a keyboard tree (role="tree"). ↑/↓ move, → opens a folder or enters it, ← closes it or goes to the parent, Home / End, Enter selects a file (or toggles a folder). Paths are the names joined by "/".

components.name: ContextMeter
components.summary: How much of the model's context window is used: a small ring and the percent (role="meter"), with the token counts in a tooltip. Turns amber from 80% and red from 95%, when the app should summarise or start a new chat.

components.name: AppHeader
components.summary: Top bar of the app (docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §4b).

components.name: AppShell
components.summary: 2-panel floating Bento shell of the Semi Design System (docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §4): - Outer bg-canvas (#111111) with md:p-2 md:gap-2 - Collapsible rounded-panel bg-panel left menu (w-52 <-> w-14 icon rail, persisted in localStorage) - Rounded-2xl bg-app right content panel with max-w-[1440px] container - Mobile (< md): hides the top logo header and renders MobileTabBar at the bottom (plus a bottom sheet if >5 routes)

components.name: AspectRatio
components.summary: Keeps media (images, video, maps, 3D previews) at a fixed ratio while the width follows the layout.

components.name: Badge
components.summary: Standard Bento Tag/Badge primitive with dual-theme tonal matching. Uses 10% alpha fill + 20% alpha border + high-contrast text adapted for dark and light modes.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.summary: Where the page sits in the app: a trail of links, the last item is the current page.

components.name: Spinner
components.summary: Indeterminate activity mark for a button or field running its own action (§13b: no page spinners).

components.name: Button
components.summary: Button and Spinner: the component form of BTN_* / MODAL_BTN_* (docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §9).

components.name: ButtonGroup
components.summary: Joins related buttons into one segmented control (Lưu | ▾, ‹ Hôm nay ›): shared borders, outer corners only.

components.name: Calendar
components.summary: A grid of days (role="grid"): arrows move by day / week, Home / End to the start / end of the week, PageUp / PageDown by month (Shift: by year), Enter / Space pick. Only the focused day is in the tab order.

components.name: Card
components.summary: Bento content card (docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §5): CARD / CARD_HOVER / CARD_ACTIVE as a component.

components.name: Carousel
components.summary: Slides in a row that scroll by swipe, trackpad, arrows or the dots (scroll-snap, no library).

components.name: BarChart
components.summary: Columns per category: grouped (default) or `stacked`. ≤24px columns with 4px rounded tops, a 2px gap between stacked segments. Hover or ←/→ on the focused chart shows every series of a category; the table view lists all values.

components.name: LineChart
components.summary: Lines over an index (usually time), 2px with an end dot; `area` adds a 10% wash under each line. A crosshair snaps to the nearest index on hover or ←/→ and lists every series.

components.name: DonutChart
components.summary: Parts of a whole (≤ 5 slices; fold the rest into "Khác"). Slices are separated by a 2px surface gap; the centre shows the total (or `centerLabel`); the legend lists every slice with its value and share.

components.name: Sparkline
components.summary: A small trend line for a KPI tile or a table cell: muted line, the last point in the accent. Decorative detail: the label states the trend for screen readers (first, last, min, max).

components.name: ChatAvatar
components.summary: Small sparkles tile in front of every AI answer (pulses while it streams).

components.name: ChatThinking
components.summary: "Đang suy nghĩ" (or what the AI is doing) with three bouncing dots, while no text has come yet.

components.name: UserMessage
components.summary: The user's message, right-aligned. `failed`: its answer failed (shown dimmed, not sent again).

components.name: AssistantMessage
components.summary: An AI answer, left-aligned behind the avatar. `actions` (copy, feedback) show under it once it is done.

components.name: ChatError
components.summary: A failed answer (or an AI note in a warning tone), with an optional retry.

components.name: ChatCopyButton
components.summary: Copies `text` (an answer, a code block); shows a check for a moment.

components.name: ChatIntro
components.summary: Icon, title and one line above an empty conversation.

components.name: ChatSuggestion
components.summary: One suggested request (a button), or with `href` a link to another site (opens outside the app).

components.name: ChatSuggestions
components.summary: A column of ChatSuggestion rows, with an optional small heading.

components.name: ChatList
components.summary: The scrolling message list (role="log"). Follows new text only while the reader is at the bottom: scrolled up to read, it stays put and offers "jump to latest". Streamed tokens are not read out one by one; when `busy` ends the finished answer (`announcement`, else "answer complete") is announced once. `empty` (only the intro / suggestions showing) keeps it at the top so the intro is read from its start.

components.name: ChatComposer
components.summary: The question field with send / stop, and an optional `toolbar` under it (model picker, attachments). Controlled: the caller keeps the text (so it can fill it, e.g. from a suggestion). Enter sends, Shift+Enter breaks the line, and Enter while an input method is composing (Vietnamese Telex / VNI, CJK) only confirms the word. Focus returns to the field once the answer to a typed question is done (not after one the app started itself: that would pop up the keyboard on a tablet).

components.name: ChatModelPicker
components.summary: Provider, model and thinking-effort chips, like the model picker of the Claude / Gemini apps; pass it as the composer `toolbar`. UI only: the app lists what is ready and remembers the pick. The provider chip shows only when more than one provider is offered, as its logo (`icon`; the name is the tooltip and the label in the list); the effort chip only when the model takes one. The chips stay usable while an answer streams (the pick applies to the next question).

components.name: ChatView
components.summary: Loading skeleton, `setup` (e.g. "AI is not set up" + a settings button) in place of the chat, or the list above the composer.

components.name: ChatPanel
components.summary: The side panel an AI conversation opens in. `placement="workspace"`: inside the nearest positioned parent, beside the content (a tool's canvas, the page). `"screen"`: over the whole page as a dialog, also above an open Modal. Phones always get the full screen. Resizable from `sm` (remembered per `widthKey`); Escape and × close it. Keep it mounted with `shown={false}` while it slides out, then unmount.

components.name: ChatAnswer
components.summary: An answer as most chats show it: the error (with retry), the Markdown text with copy, or "thinking" while empty.

components.name: AIChat
components.summary: ChatPanel + ChatView + ChatComposer with the messages drawn the standard way. The app owns `messages` and `busy`; the composer text is kept here unless `value` / `onValueChange` are passed (to fill it from a suggestion).

components.name: Chip
components.summary: On/off toggle chip (multi-select filters, outcome pickers) + the shared chip colours.

components.name: Checkbox
components.summary: Selection controls: Checkbox, Switch, RadioGroup.

components.name: Switch
components.summary: Selection controls: Checkbox, Switch, RadioGroup.

components.name: RadioGroup
components.summary: Selection controls: Checkbox, Switch, RadioGroup.

components.name: CodeBlock
components.summary: Code to read or copy: a mono block with a copy button, an optional title (file name, language) and wrapping off, so long lines scroll sideways.

components.name: Command
components.summary: The searchable list itself (inside a page, a Popover or CommandDialog). The input is an ARIA combobox that owns a listbox; the active option follows aria-activedescendant so focus never leaves the input.

components.name: CommandDialog
components.summary: The command palette over the page: a modal dialog near the top, closed by Escape, a click outside or a pick.

components.name: CustomCombobox
components.summary: Free-text input with suggestions (WAI-ARIA combobox): type to filter, ↑/↓ to move, Enter to pick, Escape to close.

components.name: CustomSelect
components.summary: App-styled dropdown (docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md: never a native <select>, its OS popup ignores the theme).

components.name: DataTable
components.summary: Sort by a column header (click again to reverse; aria-sort on the header), filter with `search` (every searchable column, case and Vietnamese marks ignored), select rows with a checkbox column (select-all on the page, bulk actions bar), page with Pagination. Shows skeleton rows while `loading` and an EmptyState when nothing is left.

components.name: DatePicker
components.summary: Date field with an app-styled calendar popover (the browser's own date popup is white and ignores the theme).

components.name: Collapsible
components.summary: One section that opens and closes under its trigger row.

components.name: Accordion
components.summary: A list of sections, one (type="single", default) or several (type="multiple") open at a time. ↑/↓ move between headers, Home / End jump; each header is a button inside a heading (level), its panel a labelled region.

components.name: Drawer
components.summary: Side sheet for secondary tasks that keep the page in view (filters, record details, settings).

components.name: ExternalLink
components.summary: Links to other sites (docs, shops): always a new tab with rel="noopener noreferrer" (docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §14).

components.name: Alert
components.summary: Callout inside a page or form (docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §3b): tinted surface, tone icon, optional action / dismiss.

components.name: Progress
components.summary: Determinate or indeterminate progress bar (uploads, quotas, print progress).

components.name: Avatar
components.summary: Person or team mark: photo, else initials on a tone picked from the name (stable per name).

components.name: EmptyState
components.summary: Empty list / first-run state: icon, one short line, optional description and action (EMPTY surface).

components.name: Field
components.summary: Form field: label + control + hint / error, wired for assistive tech (docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md "Form fields").

components.name: Input
components.summary: Text input on the field surface (FIELD_INPUT). For numbers use NumberInput, for dates DatePicker.

components.name: Textarea
components.summary: Multi-line text on the field surface (FIELD_TEXTAREA).

components.name: Icon
components.summary: Shared inline stroke icons + tinted icon tiles (docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §14–15).

components.name: IconTile
components.summary: Rounded square with an icon: the leading visual of cards, list rows and dialogs.

components.name: InputGroup
components.summary: An input with fixed parts around it: a unit (kg, ₫), a prefix (https://), an icon or a small button (copy, show).

components.name: InputOTP
components.summary: One-time code entry (OTP, PIN, 2FA): separate boxes on screen, one real input underneath, so paste, autofill from SMS (autocomplete="one-time-code"), screen readers and the native keyboard all work as for a normal field.

components.name: Item
components.summary: A list row: a leading icon / avatar / image, a title with a description, meta on the right and actions.

components.name: ItemGroup
components.summary: Rows in a card with dividers; `label` names the list for screen readers (and shows above it when visible).

components.name: Kbd
components.summary: A keyboard key or shortcut (⌘ K, Ctrl Enter) shown in menus, tooltips, the command palette and help text.

components.name: KpiCard
components.summary: KPI metric card of the Semi Design System (ported from 3D Noobs Studio jobs/ui.tsx).

components.name: Markdown
components.summary: Light markdown for AI answers: paragraphs, headings (as bold lines), lists, **bold**, `code`, links.

components.name: MobileTabBar
components.summary: Phones (< md): native-style bottom tab bar with up to 6 primary navigation items.

components.name: Modal
components.summary: Shared modal dialog of the Semi Design System (docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §14).

components.name: NavigationMenu
components.summary: Disclosure navigation (buttons with aria-expanded, not an ARIA menu): Enter / Space / ↓ open a panel, Escape closes it and returns focus, a click outside closes it; the current page link gets aria-current.

components.name: NumberInput
components.summary: Drop-in <input> for numbers: on touch screens (phone / iPad: `pointer: coarse`) it opens the app's NumPadPopup instead of the system keyboard; elsewhere it is a plain input.

components.name: Tooltip
components.summary: Short hint for an icon-only control (one line, no interactive content). The trigger keeps its own aria-label; the tooltip is linked with aria-describedby. Touch screens show nothing: never put essential text in a tooltip.

components.name: Menu
components.summary: Action menu behind a trigger button (row / card overflow actions). ↑/↓ move, Enter / Space pick, Escape closes and returns focus. Default trigger: icon-only "more" button; pass `trigger` (an element) to use your own.

components.name: ContextMenu
components.summary: The menu of an area opened at the pointer: right-click, long-press on touch, or the Menu key / Shift+F10 when the area has focus. Use for power-user shortcuts that also exist elsewhere (a row's Menu, a toolbar button).

components.name: Menubar
components.summary: The menu bar of a desktop-style tool (Tệp · Sửa · Xem): ←/→ move between menus (and switch the open one), ↓ / Enter open, the menus behave like Menu. For page navigation use NavigationMenu or AppShell instead.

components.name: PageActionsProvider
components.summary: Page-level actions (Thêm máy in, Thêm automation…) live in the top-right corner of the page header.

components.name: PageActionsSlot
components.summary: Where the actions appear: the right end of the page header row.

components.name: PageActions
components.summary: Renders its children in the page header slot (inline when the page has no slot).

components.name: PageTitle
components.summary: Page title and underline display-tab heading of the Semi Design System (docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §1, §4a).

components.name: PageTabsTitle
components.summary: Underline display tabs used when a view groups 2–4 sibling sub-pages (e.g. "Máy in / Job in", "Sản phẩm / Danh mục"). Replaces putting a separate <Pills> bar directly under a <PageTitle>.

components.name: Pagination
components.summary: Page-number pager: ‹ 1 … 4 [5] 6 … 12 ›.

components.name: Pills
components.summary: Single-choice pill group (filters, period / chart toggles).

components.name: Popover
components.summary: A non-modal dialog under its trigger. Focus moves into it; Escape, a click outside or tabbing out closes it, and Escape returns focus to the trigger. Controlled with `open` + `onOpenChange`, or on its own.

components.name: HoverCard
components.summary: A preview card while the pointer rests on (or keyboard focus is on) its trigger, usually a link. It adds detail only: touch screens never show it, so the link must work without it.

components.name: Prose
components.summary: Long-form text (help articles, release notes, policies, AI answers rendered by Markdown): headings, paragraphs, lists, links, quotes, inline code and rules styled from the type scale, on the theme's text tokens.

components.name: RefreshButton
components.summary: Icon-only "Làm mới" page action: reloads the page's data; the icon spins while the reload runs (a button running its own action may show a spinner, §13b).

components.name: ResizablePanels
components.summary: Panels side by side (or stacked) with handles to resize them: an editor beside a preview, a list beside details.

components.name: ScrollArea
components.summary: A scrolling region with a fixed size (a long list in a card, a wide table, a log).

components.name: SearchInput
components.summary: Collapsible search box: shows a search icon button by default; expands into the text field on click or when active (value is not empty).

components.name: Separator
components.summary: A thin divider between groups of content, horizontal or vertical, optionally with a short label in the middle.

components.name: SidePanelToggle
components.summary: The collapse toggle placed at the top of the panel content (next to the first label).

components.name: SidePanel
components.summary: Left settings panel of the stand-alone tool apps: bg-panel, collapses to a thin rail with the same sidebar toggle as the home menu.

components.name: Skeleton
components.summary: One shimmering block; size and radius come from className (default rounded-control).

components.name: Loading
components.summary: Wrapper that tells assistive tech the region is loading. `relative` keeps the absolute sr-only label inside scroll containers.

components.name: SkeletonCard
components.summary: Card placeholder: icon tile + two text lines, then an optional body block.

components.name: SkeletonGrid
components.summary: Grid of card placeholders (the grid classes should match the real grid).

components.name: SkeletonRows
components.summary: List row placeholders (dialog lists, tables).

components.name: PageSkeleton
components.summary: Whole-page placeholder (Suspense fallbacks): title row + a grid of cards.

components.name: Slider
components.summary: One or two thumbs (role="slider"): ←/↓ and →/↑ step, PageUp / PageDown jump 10 steps, Home / End go to the ends; drag or click the track. `value` is a number, or [low, high] with `range`.

components.name: SubpageToolbar
components.summary: Unified sticky sub-page toolbar row (docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §4a): - Left slot: filter pills / chips / CustomSelect dropdowns - Right slot: icon-only primary CTA (BTN_PRIMARY BTN_ICON) + SearchInput + RefreshButton (+ optional extra controls)

components.name: Table
components.summary: Dense data table (transactions, logs, admin lists).

components.name: THead
components.summary: Dense data table (transactions, logs, admin lists).

components.name: TBody
components.summary: Dense data table (transactions, logs, admin lists).

components.name: TR
components.summary: A clickable row (onClick) gets the hover fill and a pointer; give it a link or button inside for keyboard users.

components.name: TH
components.summary: Dense data table (transactions, logs, admin lists).

components.name: TD
components.summary: `numeric` right-aligns and sets tabular-nums (money, counts, dates); `wrap` lets long text wrap (min 12rem wide).

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: In-page tabs (WAI-ARIA tabs: ←/→/Home/End move, the active tab is the only tab stop).

components.name: Terminal
components.summary: Follows the end of the output while it streams, unless people scrolled up to read. The log is focusable (keyboard scrolling) and not a live region: output read aloud line by line would drown everything else.

components.name: ThemeToggle
components.summary: Theme toggle button: seamlessly switches between Dark and Light mode.

components.name: ThemeSwitcher
components.summary: Three-way theme picker (Sáng · Tối · Hệ thống) for settings pages and sidebar footers. ThemeToggle is the one-tap dark/light flip.

components.name: ThemeScript
components.summary: Render inside <head> of the root layout, with the same options as ThemeProvider:

components.name: ToastHost
components.summary: Toast stack: top on phones (clear of the tab bar), bottom-right from sm.

components.name: Toggle
components.summary: One button that stays pressed (aria-pressed). Icon-only needs an aria-label.

components.name: ToggleGroup
components.summary: A set of toggles on one track. type="single" (default) behaves like a radio group (←/→ move and select); type="multiple" is a toolbar of independent toggles. Value is a list of keys in both cases.

components.name: ConfirmHost
components.summary: Mounted once in the root layout; renders the dialog opened by `confirmDialog()`.

components.name: SemiLocaleProvider
components.summary: UI strings of the Semi components (labels, aria-labels, placeholders).

hooks.name: useHotkey
hooks.summary: Register a global ⌘ / Ctrl + key shortcut (default ⌘K). The handler runs on keydown; the browser action is prevented.

hooks.name: useField
hooks.summary: The surrounding Field's ids and state (null outside a Field).

hooks.name: useCoarsePointer
hooks.summary: True on devices with a touch screen (phones, tablets). Re-evaluated on change. Not just `(pointer: coarse)`: an iPad with a Magic Keyboard / trackpad (typically landscape) reports a fine primary pointer, and iPadOS "desktop website" mode looks like a Mac; both still have a touch screen (`any-pointer: coarse`, `maxTouchPoints`). Macs report 0 touch points.

hooks.name: useScrollLock
hooks.summary: Lock page scroll while `active` (nested dialogs share one lock).

hooks.name: useFocusTrap
hooks.summary: Trap keyboard focus inside `ref` while `active`; Escape calls onEscape (captured so it closes only the top dialog). Focus goes to the element with [data-autofocus] or [autofocus], else the first focusable, else the container.

hooks.name: useDialog
hooks.summary: Everything a modal-like surface needs: focus trap, scroll lock, Escape, and an id for aria-labelledby.

hooks.name: useSemiLocale
hooks.summary: Strings for the current locale (vi unless a SemiLocaleProvider says otherwise).

functions.name: chipClass
functions.summary: Colour classes of a filter chip (add CHIP_BASE + your own size). Same for every chip.

functions.name: chipIconClass
functions.summary: Text colour of a chip's leading icon: the item's tone (kept when selected, the background is what changes).

functions.name: normalizeSearch
functions.summary: Lowercase, no Vietnamese marks (đ → d): "Đơn hàng" matches "don hang".

functions.name: filterCommands
functions.summary: Items whose label, group or keywords contain every word of the query; label prefix matches first.

functions.name: pageWindow
functions.summary: Page numbers to show around `page` (1-based); `null` = an ellipsis.

functions.name: themeScript
functions.summary: Inline script that sets data-theme + .dark/.light on <html> before the first paint (no flash of the wrong theme). Keep the options identical to ThemeProvider's. Exported as a string for non-React heads.

functions.name: confirmDialog
functions.summary: Resolves true when the user picks the confirm button. A dialog opened while another shows cancels the first.

functions.name: headerPrimary
functions.summary: The app's main action at the right of the header (Slice, Phối màu, Xong).

functions.name: cn
functions.summary: Join class names, skipping falsy parts: cn(BTN_PRIMARY, busy && "opacity-60", className). Later classes are appended, not merged: to change a Semi surface pick another constant / prop instead of overriding it.

constants.name: CHAT_ROW
constants.summary: A tappable row in a chat (suggested request, follow-up choice, link): one look for all of them.

constants.name: CHAT_CHIP
constants.summary: A small label chip in a chat (events, tags the AI understands).

constants.name: CHAT_PICK_CHIP
constants.summary: A compact chip select under the composer field (provider, model, thinking effort).

constants.name: TAG
constants.summary: Static tag (a filament's brand / type on a card): same neutral background for every tag.

constants.name: TONE_DOT
constants.summary: Solid dot in a tone (material / category chips and tags).

constants.name: TILE_TONES
constants.summary: Soft tints of icon tiles: one colour per area (nav tab, page header, card headers of that area) so tabs are easy to tell apart, while chips, pills and buttons stay neutral. Tints only (15% fill + light icon), no gradients.

constants.name: TONE_TEXT
constants.summary: Icon colour of each tone when it stands alone (inactive nav item).

constants.name: TAB_BAR_PAD
constants.summary: Height of the bar above the safe area; AppShell pads its main scroll area by this much.

constants.name: STATUS_ICON
constants.summary: Icon + text colour per status tone (shared by Toast and Alert).

constants.name: HEADER_ICON_BTN
constants.summary: Icon-only header button (AI, toggles): 34 px square, bordered. Add `HEADER_ICON_ON` when on.

constants.name: HEADER_PILL
constants.summary: Round pill buttons of the header centre (file badge, save).

constants.name: VIEWPORT_TOOLBAR
constants.summary: Floating tool bar at the top centre of the 3D view (object tools).

constants.name: VIEWPORT_TOOL
constants.summary: A tool of that bar; add `VIEWPORT_TOOL_ON` when active.

constants.name: VIEWPORT_PILL
constants.summary: Undo / redo pill at the bottom centre of the 3D view.

constants.name: VIEWPORT_ROUND_BTN
constants.summary: Round view button at the bottom left of the 3D view (fit the model).

constants.name: VIEWPORT_BADGE
constants.summary: Info badge at the bottom right of the 3D view (size, count).

constants.name: BTN_PRIMARY
constants.summary: Main action (Thêm, Lưu).

constants.name: BTN_SECONDARY
constants.summary: Secondary action (Làm mới, Tính lại, Đóng).

constants.name: BTN_ICON
constants.summary: Icon-only toolbar button (Thêm, Làm mới): add to BTN_PRIMARY / BTN_SECONDARY; keep `title` + `aria-label`.

constants.name: BTN_DANGER
constants.summary: Destructive action (Dừng in, Xoá).

constants.name: MODAL_BTN_PRIMARY
constants.summary: Main action in dialogs & modals (Lưu, In lại, Gửi lệnh).

constants.name: MODAL_BTN_SECONDARY
constants.summary: Secondary action in dialogs & modals (Huỷ, Đóng).

constants.name: MODAL_BTN_DANGER
constants.summary: Destructive action in dialogs & modals (Dừng in, Xoá).

constants.name: BTN_GHOST
constants.summary: Quiet action without a surface (row actions, "Xem thêm", cancel inside a toolbar).

constants.name: BTN_SM
constants.summary: Smaller control height (28px) for dense rows: add to any BTN_* constant.

constants.name: CARD
constants.summary: Content card: panel fill, the style's card border, radius and resting shadow (Flat: thin line, no shadow). Add padding (p-4) at the call site.

constants.name: CARD_HOVER
constants.summary: Clickable card (opens a detail view).

constants.name: HERO
constants.summary: Plain hero panel at the top of a page. No glow (docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md, "Flat, no glow, no gradients").

constants.name: CARD_ACTIVE
constants.summary: Add to CARD for an active / "on" / printing card: primary border, no glow.

constants.name: STATUS_DOT
constants.summary: Flat status dot (add a size, e.g. `w-2 h-2 rounded-full`).

constants.name: STICKY_TOOLBAR
constants.summary: Sub-page toolbar row (filters left, actions right) that sticks to the top of the scrolling content panel. Bleeds to the panel's side padding so cards scroll under an opaque strip; the negative y margin keeps the layout gap unchanged. On phones it sits below the safe area, which `before:` paints over.

constants.name: TILE
constants.summary: Tonal tile inside a card (stats, readings, nested rows).

constants.name: SECTION_HEAD
constants.summary:
Section heading row:

…

3

constants.name: SECTION_LINK
constants.summary: Text link on the right of a section heading ("Quản lý ›").

constants.name: EMPTY
constants.summary: Empty state: dashed card, icon above one short line. Usually a <button> that adds the first item.

constants.name: EMPTY_STATIC
constants.summary: Non-interactive empty state (EmptyState): same dashed card as EMPTY without the hover.

constants.name: ICON_BTN
constants.summary: Square icon-only action button in a card header (edit, delete, more).

constants.name: MODAL_CLOSE
constants.summary: Close button in modal headers: visible background pill with clear contrast, easily tappable on dark backgrounds.

constants.name: STATUS_PILL
constants.summary: Status pill (device state, job result): coloured 15% fill + 300 text.

constants.name: TONAL_SURFACE
constants.summary: Dual-theme tonal surfaces: 10% alpha fill + 20% alpha border + high-contrast text adapted for both dark and light modes.

constants.name: BADGE_BASE
constants.summary: Tonal badge base class (11px or 12px pill).

constants.name: TONAL_CONTAINER
constants.summary: Dual-theme tonal container (cards, callouts, alert banners): 10% alpha fill + 20% alpha border + dual-theme text.

constants.name: TONAL_HOVER
constants.summary: Dual-theme tonal interactive hover (clickable cards, list rows, buttons): 15% hover fill + 30% hover border.

constants.name: MODAL_BACKDROP
constants.summary: Modal shell: backdrop + panel. Phones (< sm): full screen (edge-to-edge, h-dvh, rounded-none, border-0). iPad / desktop (>= sm): centred dialog (max-h-[92dvh], rounded-panel, border-line). Pass only the max-width at the call site (`max-w-md`…).

constants.name: MODAL_HEAD
constants.summary: Modal header row: icon/title left, close button right. Includes safe-area padding on mobile.

constants.name: MODAL_TITLE
constants.summary: Modal title.

constants.name: MODAL_FOOT
constants.summary: Modal footer: buttons right-aligned; stretched on a phone with safe-area bottom padding.

constants.name: FIELD_LABEL
constants.summary: Form field label above an input/select/textarea.

constants.name: FIELD_INPUT
constants.summary: Form text input: semantic field surface with crisp border-line.

constants.name: FIELD_TEXTAREA
constants.summary: Form textarea: matches FIELD_INPUT contrast and focus border.

constants.name: SHELL_OUTER
constants.summary: 2-panel floating Bento shell classes (used by AppShell).

constants.name: FOCUS_RING
constants.summary: Keyboard focus ring for custom controls (buttons, tabs, options). Visible on keyboard focus only.

constants.name: OVERLAY
constants.summary: Full-screen backdrop of modals, dialogs and sheets (themed overlay colour + blur). Add a z-* layer.
